items.title: L5 — Domain model and invariants are inherited

props.text: The proof owns one temporary browser process.

props.label: Decision
props.text: Generate the fixture, launch Chrome with an isolated user-data directory and remote-debugging endpoint, connect through CDP, run assertions, capture results, close Chrome, then remove only the scratch profile. A launch, connection or assertion failure fails the gate and preserves diagnostic output.

props.label: Why this one
props.text: Isolation avoids the user's profile and makes cleanup and failure ownership deterministic.

props.label: Other options considered (rejected)
props.text: Attach to the user's current Chrome session; rejected because tabs, extensions and profile state make results non-deterministic.
